app_name: DockSync Enterprise - Logistics Freight Appointment & QR Hub
emotional_tone: Precise, authoritative, reliable, high-efficiency industrial command center

color_system.archetype: The Performance Pro / Industrial Command Center

surface_strategies.card_style: Flat with crisp 1px border (#E2E8F0), subtle hover lift, no heavy shadows
surface_strategies.header_style: Crystal glass with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200 z-50 fixed top-0 w-full
surface_strategies.badge_style: Pill shaped with soft tinted background and bold status text

admin_role.access: Full privileges: Login, Create Appointment, Edit, Delete, Export, Dock Door Status Management

collaborator_consult_role.access: Read-only collaborative portal for warehouse floor staff, security gate, and receiving teams
features: Multi-parameter filters (Carrier, Supplier, Date range, Status)
Instant QR Code generator for daily manifests

public_qr_portal.access: Scannable QR code view for mobile consultation of today's incoming freight manifest without login required

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully responsive hybrid full-stack logistics appointment scheduling and QR consultation platform in React.js with Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and Shadcn UI primitives.

Implement two primary entry modes / view switcher in top bar: (1) Admin Management Suite (requires secure mock login toggle for Admin/Collaborator), and (2) Public / Collaborative Live Dock Board with real-time filters and daily QR code modal.
Ensure all data fields (Carrier Name, Supplier Name, Invoice/Nota Fiscal, Date, Time, Volumes, Dock Door) are fully editable in Admin mode and prominently searchable/filterable in Consult mode.
Include a dedicated 'Daily Master QR Code' feature that generates a scannable QR representation of the active daily freight schedule for security and floor staff.
Add sample pre-populated freight appointments (today and upcoming week) so the app is instantly rich and operational upon load.
Strictly follow accessibility standards, ensuring high contrast text, data-testid on all interactive elements, and no forbidden colors (#1B93A4) or forbidden fonts (space grotesk).

image_urls.description: Modern logistics warehouse loading dock with freight trucks

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_requirement: WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: Every interactive button, input, filter, and card must include a descriptive data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='appointment-submit-btn')
